raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly assumed that Gero II’s father was “likely Gero I,” which misidentified the target individual from the outset. Gero II’s father is actually Thietmar, Margrave of Meissen, whose correct date of death is 3 August 979. This premature and unverified assumption introduced confusion (later compounded by mixing up similarly named figures) and set the search off on the wrong track.
